259:t_1:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「...So the first hyperspace jump is finally here.」

259:t_1:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ opens a wormhole into subspace, and we advance through it with $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ navigating... It's quite thrilling.」

259:t_1:6.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I wonder how far this jump will take us... If things go well and we could leap about 10,000 light-years in one go, that'd be perfect.」

259:t_1:7.en:
$$カシオ$$
「If you get your hopes up too high, the shock will hit you hard when it fails.」

259:t_1:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「Ugh, how lame. Adults who can't dream.」

259:t_1:9.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Sorry about that. For being an old man.」

259:t_1:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even the one-time wild stallion has no standing before the active generation, $$カシオ$$.」

259:t_1:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It was the nickname $$カシオ$$ had back when he was an active $$トップレス$$. He got it from his extreme fighting style, which won him the top score three years in a row.」

259:t_1:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So you used to be a $$トップレス$$, $$カシオ$$!」

259:t_1:16.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And the top score three years in a row, too! That's amazing!」

259:t_1:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That was a long time ago.」

259:t_1:18.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Don't be modest, $$カシオ$$. I've heard that if you hadn't hit 《$$あがり$$》, you were a sure bet for the top spot a fourth year in a row.」

259:t_1:19.en:
$$朔哉$$
「What the heck is this $$あがり$$ thing?」

259:t_1:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then $$ノノ$$ will explain in her place! $$あがり$$ is a technical term from sushi shops, and it means, in a word, tea!」

259:t_1:22.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's wrong! Besides, that kind of thing isn't called a technical term, it's called craftsman slang!」

259:t_1:24.en:
$$チコ$$
「That sister comedy act has really 'stuck to the board' for you two, Princess.」

259:t_1:25.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Stuck to the board...? You mean chikuwa?」

259:t_1:26.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's wrong too! What sticks to a board is kamaboko!」

259:t_1:29.en:
$$ラルク$$
「S-stop it...! Quit giving me that lukewarm smile!」

259:t_1:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Give it up, Big Sis. From now on, as the beautiful comedy-duo sisters, let's aim for the top...」

259:t_1:31.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I have no intention of aiming for anything like that!」

259:t_1:32.en:
$$チコ$$
「The Princess is totally flustered, so I'll explain in her place.」

259:t_1:33.en:
$$チコ$$
「《$$あがり$$》 means losing the power of a $$トップレス$$.」

259:t_1:35.en:
$$チコ$$
「Everybody has the power of a $$トップレス$$ to some degree when they're kids...」

259:t_1:36.en:
$$チコ$$
「But once you reach a certain age, you lose it. And that goes for us in the $$フラタニティ$$ without exception.」

259:t_1:37.en:
$$くらら$$
「And after the ability is lost...」

259:t_1:38.en:
$$カシオ$$
「You either support the $$フラタニティ$$ as a coach like me, or live as an ordinary person.」

259:t_1:39.en:
$$タケル$$
「A $$トップレス$$'s super... powers are limited... Is that something no one can avoid...?」

259:t_1:40.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's right, $$タケル$$. It's not something you can use endlessly like your psychic powers.」

259:t_1:41.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So I'd rather you didn't go prying into our power this way and that.」

259:t_1:42.en:
$$タケル$$
「Sorry, $$ニコラ$$. I didn't mean it that way.」

259:t_1:44.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...Anyway, as you can see, this $$あがり$$ business can be a rather delicate issue for a $$トップレス$$.」

259:t_1:45.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Never mind me, but be considerate of the other ladies.」

259:t_1:47.en:
$$タケル$$
(The impatience and irritation inside $$ニコラ$$ that I sensed before... It surfaced a moment ago...)

259:t_1:48.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Honestly! You scared me, $$ニコラ$$! $$ノノ$$ and everyone thought you were serious!」

259:t_1:49.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Ha ha, sorry, sorry. My acting was a little too convincing.」

259:t_1:50.en:
$$葵$$
「...By the way, $$ノリコ$$... You said the other day that you and your friends had fought in the center of the galaxy, right?」

259:t_1:52.en:
$$エイーダ$$
($$葵$$... She changed the flow of the conversation nicely.)

259:t_1:53.en:
$$ジョニー$$
(She's growing too, you know. As a person, as well.)

259:t_1:54.en:
$$葵$$
「So how did you get from Earth to the galactic center back then?」

259:t_1:55.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We used the dimensional wave superstring excitation degeneracy radius jump gravity wave FTL navigation.」

259:t_1:57.en:
$$くらら$$
「S-sorry... Can you say that again?」

259:t_1:58.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The dimensional wave superstring excitation degeneracy radius jump gravity wave FTL navigation, I said.」

259:t_1:59.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Dimensional wave superstring excitation degeneracy radius jump gravity wave FTL navigation...」

259:t_1:60.en:
$$チコ$$
「As expected of an android...! You memorized it in one go!」

259:t_1:62.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'd love to hold a science lecture and explain it in detail, but...」

259:t_1:66.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's hard... If $$ガンバスター$$ could use its true power it could make short-range warps, but...」

259:t_1:67.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ right now has only one of the two degeneracy reactors it's supposed to have.」

259:t_1:68.en:
$$タケル$$
「Damage from the battles before it came to our world, huh...」

259:t_1:69.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Even if it's a parallel world, it's the same $$バスターマシン$$, so couldn't $$フラタニティ$$ technology do something about it?」

259:t_1:70.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Impossible. There's no common ground at all between that area and ours.」

259:t_1:71.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Unfortunately, voyage technology for outer space hasn't been established in our world.」

259:t_1:72.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Even the warp systems in the $$ギシン星$$ civilization sphere can't do ultra-long-range warps across the galaxy.」

259:t_1:73.en:
$$タケル$$
「I heard the distance between Earth and $$ギシン星$$ is about 1,000 light-years...」

259:t_1:74.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Even jumping that sort of distance takes a huge system and enormous energy, so it's not easy by any means.」

259:t_1:75.en:
$$ラルク$$
「In short, to get back to Earth we have no choice but to do it the slow and steady way...」

259:t_1:76.en:
$$朔哉$$
「There's still hope, $$ラルク$$. If we make good use of the $$サイデリアル$$, we might get back to Earth in no time.」

259:t_1:77.en:
$$くらら$$
「They have that much science and technology, and yet those guys still go after Earth...」

259:t_1:78.en:
$$タケル$$
「The galactic center where their main force is has all kinds of creatures hostile to humanity living there. They probably need $$次元力$$ to fight them.」

259:t_1:79.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「According to the data $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ compiled, the presence of $$宇宙怪獣$$, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, $$バジュラ$$ and $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ has been confirmed in the galactic center.」

259:t_1:80.en:
$$葵$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are who the $$人類銀河同盟$$ that $$レド$$ belonged to was fighting, right?」

259:t_1:81.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ at the galactic center... Could it be...)

259:t_1:82.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, who sought $$地球の次元力$$, probably planned to use $$次元力$$ in the fight against those creatures as well as to rule the galaxy.」
